summary: Store writers retain at most 512 MiB of WAL capacity after a reset instead of keeping multi-gigabyte high-water files indefinitely.

schema.detail: Connection-local journal_size_limit applies to the claims database and attached blob database on every writer open; no migration.

compatibility.detail: The limit controls retained capacity, not active WAL growth. Pinned readers can defer reset. Existing passive-copy and zero-wait idle TRUNCATE maintenance remain in use, with the existing bounded restart escalation under sustained growth.

manual.detail: No manual database maintenance required. Reclamation occurs when readers permit a WAL reset; a fully backfilled WAL is limited on the next writer reset.

recovery.detail: No persisted format change; older binaries can reopen the store.
